description: Offline voice dictation and speech-to-text - hold a key, speak, release. Runs on your own CPU with no cloud, no API key and no subscription.
notes: YazSes runs entirely on your machine. On first use it downloads a speech model (~141 MB) from Hugging Face; after that it needs no network at all.
Launch the tray app from the Start Menu, or run 'yazses --help' in a new terminal.
Windows builds are not code-signed yet, so SmartScreen may warn on first launch.
